function.arguments: {"finding": "The chi-squared test confirms a highly significant association between channel and customer_segment (p ≈ 0.0). This means the channels are not comparable — they attract different customer segments. The email channel is dominated by loyal customers, who have a higher baseline conversion rate, while paid_search attracts more new and returning customers. This is a strong confounder.", "implication": "The raw conversion rate difference between channels is not causal. We cannot conclude that one channel is more effective than the other without adjusting for customer_segment. The question 'Was the campaign successful?' likely refers to a campaign run on one of these channels — but we don't know which. Without a clear control group or a proper causal model, we cannot assess campaign success from this data alone. The best we can do is state that conversion varies by segment and channel, but the observed difference is confounded."}
function.name: note_finding
